arxiv-2106-05634.title: Exploring Unsupervised Pretraining Objectives for Machine Translation
arxiv-2106-05634.creator: Christos Baziotis, Ivan Titov, Alexandra Birch, Barry Haddow
arxiv-2106-05634.description: Abstract Unsupervised cross-lingual pretraining has achieved strong results in neural machine translation (NMT), by drastically reducing the need for large parallel data. Most approaches adapt masked-language modeling (MLM) to sequence-to-sequence architectures, by masking parts of the input and reconstructing them in the decoder.

arxiv-2107-02850.title: Survey of Self-Play in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2107-02850.creator: Anthony DiGiovanni, Ethan Zell, Departments of Statistics & MathematicsUniversity of Michigan {adigi,ezell}@umich.edu
arxiv-2107-02850.description: Abstract In reinforcement learning (RL), the term self-play describes a kind of multi-agent learning (MAL) that deploys an algorithm against copies of itself to test compatibility in various stochastic environments. As is typical in MAL, the literature draws heavily from well-established concepts in classical game theory and so this survey quickly reviews some fundamental concepts.

arxiv-2204-13719.title: MQT Bench: Benchmarking Software and Design Automation Tools for Quantum Computing
arxiv-2204-13719.creator: Nils Quetschlich, Lukas Burgholzer, Robert Wille
arxiv-2204-13719.description: Abstract Quantum software tools for a wide variety of design tasks on and across different levels of abstraction are crucial in order to eventually realize useful quantum applications. This requires practical and relevant benchmarks for new software tools to be empirically evaluated and compared to the current state of the art .

arxiv-2301-10361.title: Wada Boundaries on a Hyperbolic Pair of Pants
arxiv-2301-10361.creator: Pedro Henrique Barboza Rossetto, Vanessa Carvalho de Andrade, Daniel Muller
arxiv-2301-10361.description: Abstract In this paper the geodesics of an open multiply connected hyperbolic manifold are presented from the dynamical system point of view. The approach is completely numerical. Similar to the closed hyperbolic case there is a zero-measure set of periodic orbits.

arxiv-2311-12795.title: Systematically Measuring Ultra-Diffuse Galaxies (SMUDGes). VI. Nuclear Star Clusters Journal: AJ Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , GALFIT ( Peng et al. 2002 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , pandas ( McKinney 2010
arxiv-2311-12795.creator: Mika Lambert, Donghyeon J. Khim, Dennis Zaritsky, Richard Donnerstein
arxiv-2311-12795.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mika Lambert, Donghyeon J. Khim, Dennis Zaritsky, Richard Donnerstein. We present our photometric search for potential nuclear star clusters (NSCs) in ultra-diffuse galaxies (UDGs) as an extension of the SMUDGes catalog. We identify 325 SMUDGes galaxies with NSCs and, from the 144 with existing distance estimates, identify 33 NSC hosts as UDGs ( μ 0 , g \mu_{0,g} ≥ \geq 24 mag arcsec -2 , r e ≥ 1.5 r_{e}\geq 1.5 kpc).

arxiv-2410-20323.title: Probing charged lepton flavor violation in an economical muon on-target experiment
arxiv-2410-20323.creator: Leyun Gao, Zijian Wang, Cheng-en Liu, Jinning Li, Alim Ruzi, Qite Li, Chen Zhou, Qiang Li
arxiv-2410-20323.description: Abstract This work proposes a new yet economical experiment to probe the charged lepton flavor violation (CLFV) process mediated by an extra massive neutron gauge boson Z ′ Z^{\prime} beyond the standard model, by extending a recently proposed muon dark matter project in the Peking University Muon (PKMuon) Experiment.

arxiv-2502-15442.title: Learning Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Skills via Privileged Action
arxiv-2502-15442.creator: Xiaofeng Mao, Yucheng Xu, Zhaole Sun, Elle Miller, Daniel Layeghi, Michael Mistry
arxiv-2502-15442.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaofeng Mao, Yucheng Xu, Zhaole Sun, Elle Miller, Daniel Layeghi, Michael Mistry. Long-horizon contact-rich tasks are challenging to learn with reinforcement learning, due to ineffective exploration of high-dimensional state spaces with sparse rewards. The learning process often gets stuck in local optimum and demands task-specific reward fine-tuning for complex scenarios. In this work, we propose a structured framework that leverages privileged actions with curriculum learning, enabling the policy to efficiently acquire long-horizon skills without relying on extensive reward engineering or reference trajectories.

pmc-11368751.creator: Pei Sha, Xing Gao, Ran Yu, Ying Li, Yameng Zhang, Ziyu Zhu, Ting Wu, Chang Liu
pmc-11368751.description: IntroductionThis research seeks to investigate how early rehabilitation nursing, guided by Orem’s self-care theory, affects cognitive function, neurological function, and daily living skills in individuals who have suffered a traumatic brain injury (TBI).MethodsA study was conducted with 108 patients with traumatic brain injury who were hospitalized at our facility from January 2021 to March 2023.

pmc-11638928.title: Cross-Electrophile Coupling: Principles, Methods, and Applications in Synthesis
pmc-11638928.creator: Lauren
pmc-11638928.description: Cross-electrophile coupling (XEC), defined by us as the cross-coupling of two different σ-electrophiles that is driven by catalyst reduction, has seen rapid progression in recent years. As such, this review aims to summarize the field from its beginnings up until mid-2023 and to provide comprehensive coverage on synthetic methods and current state of mechanistic understanding.

pmc-12464894.title: Chronic Pain and Labour Market Affiliation: Effect of Demographic Factors and Comorbidities 5 Years Before and 2 Years After Multidisciplinary Treatment

pmc-12464894.description: PurposeThis study investigates the association of sociodemographic factors and comorbidities with labour market affiliation among patients with non‐malignant chronic pain treated at multidisciplinary pain centres in Denmark.MethodsThis registry‐based cohort study used data from the nationwide Danish Civil Registration System and Danish National Patient Registry. pmc-12563997.title: Development of Fermented Cricket Paste and Its Characteristic Comparison with Traditional Fermented Shrimp Paste (terasi)
pmc-12563997.creator: Reggie Surya, Felicia Tedjakusuma, Kantiya Petsong, Aphinya Thinthasit, David Nugroho, Raquel P F Guiné
pmc-12563997.description: The demand for sustainable protein has increased interest in edible insects, and fermentation can improve the sensory and nutritional profiles of novel foods. This study aimed to develop a fermented cricket paste using a method analogous to traditional shrimp paste and evaluate the physiochemical, nutritional, microbiological, and sensory properties.

pmc-12587054.title: An assessment of cetacean welfare in the Faroe Islands’ drive hunt
pmc-12587054.creator: Alick G Simmons, Rebecca M. Boys, Laetitia Nunny, Mark P. Simmonds
pmc-12587054.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Drive hunts in the Faroes and Japan typically involve prolonged herding of cetaceans (over hours or even days) into shallow water, forced stranding, restraint and killing using a spinal lance and exsanguination. These methods raise significant animal welfare concerns. This study applies the Five Domains Model to the Faroe Islands’ grindadráp hunt to consider potential welfare implications and associated affective states. We examined published hunting guidelines and divided the hunt into six stages.

pmc-12617959.title: Evaluation of Cancer Survivors’ Experience of Using AI-Based Conversational Tools: Qualitative Study
pmc-12617959.creator: Saif Khairat, Hanna Mehraby, Safoora Masoumi, Melissa Coffel, Callie Rockey-Bartlett, Andrea Huang, William Wood, Ethan Basch
pmc-12617959.description: BackgroundCancer survivorship is a complicated, chronic, and long-lasting experience, causing uncertainty and a wide range of physical and emotional health concerns. Due to the complexity of cancer, patients often seek out multiple sources of health information to better understand the aspects of their cancer diagnosis.

pmc-12852680.title: Impacts of cold stress and temperature fluctuations on bud abortion and malformed flower development on Hayward kiwifruit
pmc-12852680.creator: Maryam Mirarzgar, Mahmood Ghasemnezhad, Reza Fotouhi Ghazvini, Jalal Jalali Sendi
pmc-12852680.description: This study investigated the effects of cold stress and fluctuating temperatures on bud abortion and flower malformation in one-year-old dormant canes of ‘Hayward’ kiwifruit (Actinidia deliciosa). Cuttings were collected from a commercial orchard in Rasht, Iran, and standardized prior to exposure.

pmc-13256067.title: The Dual Role of Ferroptosis in Cancer: Molecular Mechanisms, Microenvironment Crosstalk, and Precision Therapeutics
pmc-13256067.creator: Yu Zhu, Meijia Chen, Jianglong Chen, Junjie Wang, Rujie Zhou, Yunfei Cui, Guang Li
pmc-13256067.description: Simple SummaryCancer remains a major global health challenge, and many patients eventually become resistant to standard treatments that rely on traditional cell death pathways. This article explores a recently discovered process called ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of cell death caused by the accumulation of damaged fats within the outer layers of cells.

pmc-13392745.title: Poly(Glycerol‐Sulfur) as a Functional Sustainable Nanomaterial: Synthesized by Anionic Ring Opening Polymerization of Elemental Sulfur
pmc-13392745.creator: Paraskevi S. Stergiou, Mariam Cherri, Philip Nickl, Elisa Quaas, Katharina Achazi, Mathias Dimde, Mohsen Adeli, Rainer Haag
pmc-13392745.description: Elemental sulfur is an abundant by‐product of the petroleum industry, yet its controlled incorporation into functional polymer architectures remains challenging. Here, we report a one‐pot, moderate‐temperature (120°C) anionic copolymerization of elemental sulfur (S8) with glycidol to produce hyperbranched poly(glycerol‐sulfur)s with tunable molecular weights (5–30 kDa) and sulfur contents (3–11 wt%) on the gram scale.

pmc-13399623.title: Arthroscopic Posterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using a Pedicled Semitendinosus Autograft Through a Trans‐Septal Approach: A Technical Note
pmc-13399623.creator: Ali Alayane, Vincent Marot, Dany Mouarbes, Léon Ortal, Ariane Le Cunf, Regis Pailhe, Etienne Cavaignac
pmc-13399623.description: Isolated posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) ruptures are relatively uncommon among knee ligament injuries. Operative management is recommended for patients with grade III posterior knee joint laxity. The complex anatomy of the PCL, particularly its course and insertion on the femur and the tibia, makes its reconstruction technically challenging.

pmc-13521248.title: CHRONIC ACTINOMYCES NEUII ENDOPHTHALMITIS POSTCATARACT SURGERY TREATED WITH INTRAVENOUS AND INTRAMUSCULAR ANTIBIOTICS AND INTRAOCULAR LENS EXPLANTATION: CASE REPORT AND REVIEW OF THE LITERATURE
pmc-13521248.creator: Carol Tadrous, Nadine Cheffi, Rishi B. Gupta, Jonathan B. Angel, Bernard R. Hurley, Chloe C. Gottlieb
pmc-13521248.description: Chronic postoperative endophthalmitis is a rare complication of cataract surgery. This case of recalcitrant Actinomyces neuii chronic postoperative endophthalmitis was successfully treated with prolonged IV and intramuscular antibiotics alongside intraocular lens explantation. This report highlights the importance of interdisciplinary management and systemic antibiotic therapy in persistent chronic postoperative endophthalmitis caused by unusual pathogens.

pmc-13536918.title: Assessment of Phenotype, Oxidative Stress and Biomacromolecule Oxidation in Human Chronic Skin Wound Epidermis in Active Debridement Tissue Versus Endstage Wounds
pmc-13536918.creator: Dylan Tinney, Justin Carmichael, Punkuj Chawla, David Keast, Douglas W Hamilton
pmc-13536918.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Impairment of cutaneous healing occurs in association with numerous comorbidities including diabetes, vascular insufficiency and immobility. Standard management of chronic wounds includes removal of necrotic tissue and infection management, but no biomarkers are used to guide appropriate debridement distance. We hypothesized that by understanding the spatial distribution of proteins associated with keratinocyte differentiation and activation, oxidative stress biomarkers, as well as accumulation of oxidative damage, debridement protocols could be refined.

pmc-13660282.title: Beyond single encounters: a mixed methods study of access to continuous asthma care using Levesque’s framework
pmc-13660282.creator: Irem Sevik, Meltem Ciceklioglu, Gulistan Karadeniz
pmc-13660282.description: BackgroundAchieving symptom control in asthma depends on regular follow-up and access to continuous care, and inadequate control is associated with reduced quality of life and increased healthcare utilization. This study aimed to examine access to continuous care and associated factors among adult asthma patients attending tertiary care, and to explore the dynamics of continuity through patient experiences.
